dedupe_keys.name: cpt based liquefaction case histories from global earthquakes a digital dataset

description: CPT-Based Liquefaction Case Histories from Global Earthquakes: A Digital Dataset is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Brett Maurer, University of Washington (washington.edu). This dataset contains 332 CPT-based liquefaction case histories from 25 globally distributed earthquakes. These data, or subsets of these data, have been analyzed in the literature and are provided here to replicate published results. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project with 2 top-level files (MAT, PDF). Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-8hvd-hd43. Keywords: liquefaction, CPT, case history database, surface manifestations. Published 2024-12-06. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
